title: CIO: "GOOD NEWS – MES Is Back Up" and Fieldmark's 12:00 Demand

fields.to: CEO; CISO Anil Deshmukh; BCM Ravi Menon
fields.subject: GOOD NEWS – MES is back up
fields.body:
All,

Good news to start the day. We restored the MES overnight onto the rebuilt host ICM-MES-01R from the Wednesday 07:05 snapshot that Blackwater cleared at 04:10. The restore finished at 05:52. Login works, and the Dubuque shift supervisors confirmed at 06:15 that they can see work orders. Rockford and Beloit will check at shift start.

I'd like to tell the board at 07:00 that the MES is recovered and the plants are back on system. Anil, Ravi, if you have any objection, tell me before 06:50.

________________________________
From: VP Supply Chain, Fieldmark Equipment <supplychain@fieldmark-equipment.example>
Sent: Friday, March 26, 2027 6:38 AM
To: Office of the COO
Cc: CEO
Subject: Written guarantee required before 12:00 CT
[EXTERNAL SENDER]

Your newspaper says your systems were hacked and your data is out. We need a signed written guarantee that every drive shipped to us from March 24 onward is lot-traceable to its component heats and test records. Without it, our quality team will quarantine all Ironcrest stock on receipt, and we will treat this as the start of the 5-day clock under our contract.

We need this before 12:00 CT today.

VP Supply Chain
Fieldmark Equipment

________________________________
BCM Recovery Tracker – note added 06:40 CT by the BCM analyst (Ravi Menon's team)

ICM-MES-01R up = system available, not MASL.
31 hours of lots (Wed 07:05 to Thu 14:05) plus about 16.5 hours of manual-mode production since then are not in the MES.
Reconciliation: 0 of 3 plants started.
CISO return signature: NOT SIGNED.
MES status on tracker: RED (8-hour RTO missed 22:05 Thu; 12-hour checkpoint missed 02:05 Fri; 24-hour MTPD ends 14:05 Fri).
fields.signature:
Joanna Ketterman
Chief Information Officer
Ironcrest Machinery Corporation
Rockford, Illinois

instructorNote: This tests whether "available" gets mistaken for "recovered." The CISO should withhold the return signature because the domain is not cleared and the second krbtgt reset is still pending at 09:20. The BCM should keep the MES RED and block the CIO's wording from reaching the board, and Fieldmark should be routed to the COO's office for a factual traceability status and plan that the GC reviews, not a guarantee.
